chart.subtitle: Annual population change determined by births and deaths. Migration is not included.

Natural population growth rate - Sex: al.titleLong: Natural population growth rate - UN WPP
Natural population growth rate - Sex: al.descriptionShort: Births minus deaths, as a share of the population. This is the part of population change that comes only from births and deaths, ignoring migration.
descriptionKey: Migration is *not* included. To see how births, deaths, and migration combine, look at the [overall population growth rate](https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/population-growth-rates).
Natural population growth rate - Sex: al.descriptionProcessing: The UN publishes the rate of natural change per 1,000 people. We divide by 10 to express it as a percentage.
